primary_source.title: Divergence of the correlation length for critical planar FK percolation with 1<=q<=4 via parafermionic observables
primary_source.author: Hugo Duminil-Copin

known_boundary_fact: At q=4, ordinary spin-one local relation is path flux conservation at every p; the winding-weighted G observable is the relevant replacement.
current_literature_check: Search returned a recent AI-manuscript secondary index. Its claimed convergence results have not been checked from a primary proof; not accepted as established status.
hardest_gap: Uniform control of normalized winding-weighted endpoint observables through delta->0 in slit domains, sufficient for SLE(4) identification.
